games.reason: Both chains have in-vitro allele-binding predictions and expressed nominated TFs, with no variant-local ChIP-seq support to distinguish them. F2 is better supported because its model predicts a stronger allelic effect (z 23.6; alt-favouring, with alt site strength 95.1 versus ref 21.9), while F3’s effect is smaller (|z| 18.37; ref-favouring). F3 also leaves TFAP2E assignment less resolved because TFAP2A and TFAP2C are expressed too. This is a comparative edge in binding prediction and TF assignment, not evidence of in-vivo occupancy or a causal disease link.

F2 is modestly better supported: its ZNF696 model predicts a more discriminating allele preference (alt 95.1th-percentile site strength versus ref 21.9th; E14), while F3’s TFAP2E model favors ref but both allele strengths remain high (E15). Expression is similar, and neither chain has variant-local ChIP evidence. F3 additionally has expressed AP-2 paralogs that leave the acting member unresolved; the available evidence does not establish in-vivo occupancy for either chain.
